observed_reality: The active owner policy requires Clay Machine execution evidence to come from isolated sandboxes rather than VPS/self-hosted execution.

Vercel deployment dpl_ESwWufAfNd36LRYBza5FpBZsnYco cloned exact product head 33424a2e86545ef45ee6824a900fd0c6845f7a0b and its build logs recorded an actually-started Vercel Sandbox batch.

A separate concurrent GO lane later produced another actually-started build-time Vercel Sandbox receipt for exact head 1c6486593471b0b3b32ee4f7ac44fda34258005b; it is preserved as parallel evidence and is not counted as this worker macro-cycle's unusual experiment.
grf.generated_hypothesis: A fixed build-internal Vercel job can provide a compliant isolated execution lane that binds one exact source head, builds the one-file EntityOS candidate, exercises deterministic offline gates, and stops the Sandbox without using VPS/self-hosted execution.
grf.counter_reality: A READY Vercel deployment or successful serverless build may exist without any Sandbox execution; checkout-derived archives or import-capable ignored files may weaken source attribution; a reusable HTTP route/static nonce can create unnecessary replay/exposure surface; and an exact-head PASS becomes stale when main or the candidate changes.
grf.discriminating_observation: Require actual Sandbox execution, exact source identity binding, all matrix step exit codes, deny-all network during tests, exact EntityOS digest, duplicate-run suppression, clean Sandbox stop, and fresh-head provenance checks before promotion.
grf.outcome: RETAIN the Vercel Sandbox execution lane; DEFER promotion of any tested historical digest to current main.

architecture_delta.rule: Vercel Sandbox is supported as an isolated exact-head execution lane when the job is fixed/bounded and preferably build-internal, source identity is independently bound, post-provision test networking is denied, exact one-file EntityOS output is measured, duplicate execution is suppressed, and Sandbox stop is observed. A deployment READY state alone remains insufficient evidence.
